anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

choices.why: Casual readers think the two words are the same.

pass_a_gloss: And many such things according to the writing will be shown, seeming to those reading as a side-work to have sameness, but to those encountering with care and attention being proved to have been divided.
pass_b_english: And many such things in Scripture will be shown, which seem to those who read in passing to have sameness, but to those who meet them with care and attention are proved to have been distinguished.
source_text: Καὶ δειχθήσεται πολλὰ τοιαῦτα [κα]τὰ τὴν γραφήν, δοκοῦ[ντα] μὲν τοῖς παρέργως ἀ[ναγι]νώσκουσιν ταυτότη[τα ἔχει]ν, τοῖς δὲ μετ’ ἐπιμελείᾳ[ς κ]αὶ ἐπιστάσεως ἐντυγχά[νο]υσιν ἀποδεικνύμενα δι[ῃρ]ῆσθαι.
